text: AI's role in legal practice must remain that of a supportive tool rather than a replacement for human judgment, because AI augments legal practice but cannot replicate the empathy and discretion that responsive judging requires.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Morgan A. Gray, The Evolving Role of Artificial Intelligence in Law (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5541658

isBasedOn.name: The Evolving Role of Artificial Intelligence in Law

abstract: AI's role as a supportive tool, rather than a replacement for human judgment, is critical. As emphasized in multiple studies, AI augments legal practice but cannot replicate the empathy and discretion required for responsive judging.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: judicial and adjudicative functions, as distinct from transactional or administrative legal tasks
